CourtPoint.description: Metres on the court floor (see the module docstring for the frame).
CourtPoint.title: CourtPoint

CourtView.description: One camera range with one court fit. Frames are half-open.
CourtView.title: CourtView

DistanceStats.description:
Distance covered on the court floor during rallies (feet, metres).

``total_m`` adds every tracked span of every rally (a lower bound when
coverage is below 1); ``per_minute_m`` is it per tracked minute.
``per_rally`` lists every rally; ``rally_m`` summarises the rallies that
are at least MIN_COVERAGE tracked.
DistanceStats.title: DistanceStats

Distribution.description:
A Summary with a histogram: bin i holds edges[i] <= v < edges[i + 1];
``below`` and ``above`` count values outside the edges.
Distribution.title: Distribution

FinishStats.description: Rally-ending shots of this side with a known outcome.
FinishStats.title: FinishStats

Formation.description:
Doubles formation from the 10 Hz tracks during rallies. Attacking and
defending follow the last shot played (see ATTACKING and DEFENDING).
Formation.title: Formation

FormationShare.description: Samples with both partners tracked and at least FORMATION_MIN_M apart.
FormationShare.title: FormationShare

Grid.description:
Counts on court cells, rows along the court (y), columns across (x).

``counts[row][column]`` covers y_edges[row]..y_edges[row + 1] and
x_edges[column]..x_edges[column + 1], in metres, with the player turned
to the near end. ``n`` samples fell on the grid and ``outside`` beyond
it; ``seconds`` is ``n`` at the track rate.
Grid.title: Grid

ImagePoint.description: Normalized image coordinates: 0..1 of the oriented frame width/height.
ImagePoint.title: ImagePoint

Landing.description:
Where the last shot came down, from the shuttle's image track.

``position`` is the floor point under the image point where the shuttle
stopped descending, through the camera recovered from the court view
(the shuttle's centre is taken a few centimetres above the floor), or
where the fitted 3D flight meets the floor when the track ended in the
air (null when it lies more than COURT_MARGIN_M outside the court); ``kind`` is rest (it then lay still), descent (it
stopped going down) or track_end (its track ended in the air, so the
position is unreliable). ``in_court`` uses the rally lines: singles or
doubles sidelines and the full length.
Landing.title: Landing

LandingSpot.description: Where a rally's last shot came down (the hitter at the near end).
LandingSpot.title: LandingSpot

PersonSwap.description: A user correction: two persons swapped over a frame range (inclusive).
PersonSwap.title: PersonSwap

RallyOutcome.description:
Who won the rally and how, from the outcomes stage.

The reason is the last hitter's: ``winner`` when the last hitter won (the
shot landed in), ``error`` when the last hitter lost it (``out``, or
``net``: it did not get over). ``winner_end`` is the court end of the
winning side when the rally ended; ``winner_team`` is the team found at
that end (null when no identified player was seen there).
RallyOutcome.title: RallyOutcome

RallyScore.description:
Points counted from the start of the video, not the official score.

A rally whose winning team is unknown leaves the score unchanged. A game
ends at 21 (two clear, at most 30); the next rally starts game + 1.
RallyScore.title: RallyScore

ReturnStats.description: The shot after a serve, played by this side.
ReturnStats.title: ReturnStats

SequenceCount.description:
Consecutive shot labels within a rally, with how often they occur
(``count`` of every eligible sequence of that length).
SequenceCount.title: SequenceCount

ShotBreakdown.description:
Contacts by kind and label. ``families`` and ``sides`` are shares of
``shots`` (contacts recognised as shots); ``serve_types`` of ``serves``.
ShotBreakdown.title: ShotBreakdown

ShotFlight.description:
The shot's 3D flight fitted to the shuttle's image track (outcomes stage).

Gravity plus air drag from the hitter to the next contact (the last shot:
to its landing), through the camera recovered from the court view. Only
``quality == "good"`` speeds are measurements; ``speed_bound`` fits hit the
fit's speed limit and their speed is not known (see FLIGHT_SPEED_BOUND_KMH).
ShotFlight.title: ShotFlight

ShotResult.description:
One shot label's results. ``played`` counts the shots of the label,
leaving out rally-ending shots whose outcome is unknown.
ShotResult.title: ShotResult

SpeedStats.description:
Fitted shot speeds of one label (see docs/CLIP_STATS.md for limits).

``initial_kmh`` and ``apex_m`` use only good fits; ``settled_kmh`` (0.1 s
after the contact) also uses speed_bound fits, which fix it well. Speed
min and max are null: single fits do not name a fastest shot.
SpeedStats.title: SpeedStats

Spot.description: One shot on a court map (metres, turned; see the module docstring).
Spot.title: Spot

Summary.description: Numbers summarised; every value is null when ``n`` is 0.
Summary.title: Summary

schema.title: Response List Matches Api Matches Get

post.description:
Upload a match with its players' names and start the one job.

Names: singles one per team, doubles two per team (partners). The
same video uploaded again reuses the stored video and its finished
processing stages.

409.description: Another job is running, or format mismatch

get.description: State, one overall progress value 0..1 and a stage label.

404.description: Unknown match or results not built yet

post.description: Ask the running job to stop; finished stages are kept for resuming.

get.description:
Each person found, with team, the guessed or confirmed name and a
picture.

put.description:
Confirm which entered name belongs to which person (swaps allowed;
doubles partners stay on one team). Rebuilds the document.

delete.description: Remove every swap made on this rally.

post.description:
Swap two persons for one rally (usually partners). The same swap
again undoes it. Stored as an override; the document is rebuilt.
Run the match job again, reusing every finished stage.

404.description: Unknown match or results not built yet

get.description: The stored per-match results document; read-only, never rebuilt here.

404.description: Video unknown or results not built yet

get.description: Whole-clip statistics of the stored MatchAnalysis document.

404.description: Video unknown or results not built yet
